Cole Palmer withdraws from England squad due to injury

Cole Palmer has withdrawn from the latest England squad due to a muscle injury. He was expected to be a key player for the upcoming matches. Three players in total are reportedly set to withdraw from the squad, with Manchester United duo also being doubts.
